biggest_catch: Friend must open a membership share savings account plus at least one additional deposit or consumer loan account (minimum $100 funding).
catches: Referrer gets $50 for every referral; both the referrer and the person referred receive $50 when the friend opens a new account.
Friend must be over 18 and open a DFCU membership via a share savings account plus at least one additional deposit or consumer loan account.
Additional deposit account must be funded with a minimum of $100; overdraft line of credit, credit cards, and mortgage loans excluded.
Referrer must be a current DFCU member in good standing.
Allow 30 days after account opening for the incentive to be credited.
